name: §1 trust claim
old:
You say what an agent may touch before it starts, and what it did is checked against the record of the
turn rather than taken on its word: by default, an agent that ran nothing comes back failed, not finished.
new:
You say what an agent may touch before it starts. The rights it got and whether it ran anything are read
from the record of the turn, not taken on its word: by default, an agent that ran nothing comes back
failed, not finished.

name: §4 marketplace removal
old:
Removing the
*marketplace* instead uninstalls every plugin that came from it — run `/codex-delegate:cleanup` first if
any of it matters.
new:
Removing the
*marketplace* instead uninstalls every plugin that came from it and deletes their stored data too; copy
the directory named under [What it stores](#what-it-stores-and-what-leaves-your-machine) first if any
of it matters.

name: §5 read grant
old:
It reads anything you can read; the only thing it
  may write is a scratch space of its own, which is enough for most test suites but not for browser tests.
new:
It reads anything you can read, and your system
  temp directory is the only thing it may write — enough for most test suites, not for browser tests.

name: §6 temp directory
old: - **your system temp directory** — that scratch space, one per agent; your machine clears it.
new:
- **your system temp directory** — each agent's prompt file, and whatever a read-only agent writes while
  it works.
